newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 4.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 4.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:

- Some 30 to 40 thousand depositors withdrew a total amount of 22 to 23 billion forints from run-hit Postabank, chairman and general manager Princz said. However, the run appears to be over, Prime Minister Gyula Horn said
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn is ready to negotiate with farmers who held demonstrations since last Monday in protest against 1997 tax rules.
- Hungarian-Austrian cross-border traffic has slowed down substantially as Austrian officials made the customs control of trucks stricter following catching illegal immigrants.
- Hungarian president Arpad Goncz began talks in Lithania.
